cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I know. Coming wouldn't mean much if you had nothing else to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. I'm trying to discover whether I'm more than the convenient option.
